## Problem this solves

What is the friction or missing capability today? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution

What would you like the launcher to do? Be concrete — UI sketch, command, config flag, etc.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve this you've thought about, and why this is better.

## Additional context

Mockups, links to similar features in other tools, related issues.
